kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Greetings from a surreal expanse of sand dunes dotted with freshwater lagoons in Brazil
wire.summary: The pristine white sand dunes of the Lençóis Maranhenses National Park are bordered by thick jungle on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other. Thousands of lagoons fill up after the rainy season.

wire.title: His wedding guests gave $6k to fund a health startup. Now it's won a $3 million prize
wire.summary: Dr. Raj Panjabi founded Last Mile Health to bring healthcare to people living in remote areas. The group is the 2026 recipient of the Conrad N. Hilton Humanitarian Prize.

wire.title: Zhu Rongji, who drove China's 1990s economic reforms, has died at 97
wire.summary: Zhu was renowned for reforms that sought to transition China from the post-Maoist years to a more global market-oriented financial system, without ceding party control over the economy.

wire.title: Takeaways from Tuesday primaries. And, Iran threat prompted Trump's secret plane swap
wire.summary: Yesterday's primaries provided more insight into what voters in both parties want from their new leaders. And, Trump secretly switched planes in Turkey last month amid a foreign threat

wire.title: Andrew Tate's extradition fight tests his influence with Trump's America
wire.summary: After President Trump took office, Andrew Tate proclaimed, "The Tates will be free." A year later, Tate is being held in federal prison after he was arrested following a U.K. extradition request.

wire.title: Feel so busy you don't even realize you're busy? Try doing a time audit
wire.summary: The exercise can help you identify what's wasting your time — and make room for what matters, says psychotherapist Niro Feliciano. Take a moment to try it. You might be surprised with what you find.

wire.title: Are hacks of U.S. water facilities a new front in the Iran war?
wire.summary: A recent series of cyberattacks on U.S. water systems has exposed vulnerabilities across critical infrastructure during the Iran war.

wire.title: Nuclear power push ramps up uranium mill — and tribal health concerns
wire.summary: Federal efforts to revive uranium mining in the West and decrease reliance on Russian uranium raise concerns about drinking water for tribal communities reckoning with the industry's deadly legacy.

wire.title: Here's how gyms, salons and ice cream are changing America's Main Streets
wire.summary: Shoppers' changing habits are fueling a major shift in what types of businesses are occupying storefronts.

wire.title: How a road could change West Africa's urban future
wire.summary: A 600-mile journey along the shores of Nigeria, Togo, Ghana and Ivory Coast reveals one of the world's most consequential transformations.

wire.title: Trump confirms he switched planes after Nato summit because of possible threat
wire.summary: Journalists and White House staff who were on board the jet were unaware the president had left.

wire.title: Trump's dramatic plane swap hints at personal stakes of Iran war
wire.summary: It marks another striking episode in the turbulent history of his relationship with Iran, writes the BBC's Anthony Zurcher.

wire.title: Woman pulled alive from rubble 36 hours after Colombia quake
wire.summary: Following a 10-hour rescue operation, emergency workers pulled the 32-year-old from beneath slabs of concrete.

wire.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
wire.summary: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn and about a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site where two families have been besieged since Sunday.

wire.title: US inflation eases as food costs cool
wire.summary: Annual US inflation dipped to 3.4% in July, with food costs slowing and housing keeping prices slightly higher.

wire.title: Danube river's low water levels reveal remains of WWII soldiers and motorcycle
wire.summary: A remarkably well-preserved motorcycle and identification tags were found alongside the bodies.
